extDescription.message: Saves articles, selected text, bookmarks and screenshots to MindNotes.

commandClipArticle.message: Save the article to MindNotes without the popup

errOffline.message: MindNotes is not responding. Start the app and turn on the Web Clipper plugin.

errPage.message: The browser does not let extensions read this page. Save it as a bookmark or a screenshot.

errSelection.message: Select some text on the page first.

errDisabled.message: The plugin is turned off in MindNotes: Settings → Extensions.

offlineText.message: MindNotes is not responding. Start the app and check that the Web Clipper plugin is on in Settings → Extensions.

pairText.message: Connect the extension to MindNotes. The app will ask for permission — confirm it there.

pairWait.message: Answer the question in the MindNotes window…

noWorkspaceText.message: No workspace is open in MindNotes. Open one and try again.
